_comment: Shared by the Godot game (game/) and the Python backend (backend/). Units: robot mm, world cm.

robot._z_note: Z is reported by the backend in abstract 'z units' (0..z_max) derived from the STS3020 ID1 drum servo count (SERVO_STATUS abs=). The firmware has no Z homing; the backend defines 0 at the position seen when 'z_zero' is sent. If a LARGER value means the arm is HIGHER set z_up_is_positive=true. The on-screen rope is longest when the arm is highest (inverse mapping).

world._fit_note: true: the robot's X range spans the play area width (computed at runtime from the window, the debug panel and the projection); false: fixed travel_x_cm.

audio._note: Sound effects from 効果音ラボ (soundeffect-lab.info). In game/assets/audio/ as part of the game; do not hand the files out on their own (see SOURCES.md there). up/down = the UFO rising/sinking on screen (arm going down/up).

gesture._note: Pinch hand joystick (backend: --gesture). delegate = gpu (Metal: faster, and frees the CPU for the game). MediaPipe 1.1.1's GPU path keeps one image per frame (~1 GB per 30 s, aborting after ~8 min with 'Error creating pixel buffer: -6662') until the landmarker is closed, so it is rebuilt on a thread and swapped in every gpu_recreate_s. detection_confidence / tracking_confidence = MediaPipe's thresholds (tracking low so a fast, blurred hand is kept). pinch_start 1.0 / pinch_release 1.5 / confirm 0 were tuned by hand on the C270 (open the hand wide to release: check the ratio goes above 1.5). stale_ms = an event older than this stops the stick (CPU MediaPipe frames occasionally take 200-280 ms on an M4 MacBook Air; 150 stopped every few seconds). camera = part of the gesture camera's name (or an index). Pinch = |thumb tip - index tip| / hand size (the larger of |index MCP - pinky MCP| and 0.75 x |wrist - middle MCP|): starts <= pinch_start held pinch_confirm_ms, ends >= pinch_release held release_confirm_ms (tunable live from the debug panel: the gesture_config command). A hand lost (or a second hand / ambiguous) for less than lost_grace_ms keeps the last good frame (MediaPipe drops a moving hand for a frame or two). min_confidence gates the left/right score (0 = off: it drops for a hand seen from above). roi = operating region [x0, y0, x1, y1] in normalised image coords (keep it outside the crane's reach). joystick: radius = fraction of the image short side, deadzone / full = fractions of the radius, speed = ((r - deadzone)/(full - deadzone))^curve * max_speed_mm_s. allow_real_robot: true since the gesture was checked with the mock (2026-10-25); the robot must still be connected, motors on, homed, no alarm, nothing else moving (H toggles the mode).

camera._note: USB cameras by role (C270 = overview / gesture, Innomaker U20CAM = arm tip): overview = looks down on the desk (gesture detection later), focus = on the arm tip. match = part of the camera name (empty = none; pick one in the debug panel). The scope view shows focus, or overview when there is no focus camera. Frames are only drawn: never saved or sent.

backend._note: z_counts_per_unit: servo counts per abstract Z unit (4096 counts/turn; 3 turns = 12288 counts = 100 units). z_sign: +1 if positive SERVO_TURN raises the arm, -1 otherwise (set on the real machine). jog_max_mm_s: speed cap for serial JOG (firmware recommends <= 50 mm/s).
